_comment: Feature metadata for the Help system (help-system spec 5).
Panels carry only an id, a kind and a document here. Their name, their description and the
region they dock into are NOT restated: they are read from ui::editorPanels() at startup, which
is the registry that already owns them. Duplicating them would create a second place to forget
to edit, which is exactly the drift this file exists to avoid.
Commands and shortcuts ARE written out, because the application has no command registry to
derive them from -- they are inline ImGui and SDL calls. avgen_help_lint scans those call sites
and reports anything here the source does not have, and anything the source has that is not
here. When a command registry lands, these rows become derived too and this file shrinks.

features.name: Open Audio...
features.summary: Load an audio file and cut the camera to it.

features.name: Open Scene (glTF)...
features.summary: Load a .gltf or .glb scene.

features.name: Open Environment (HDR)...
features.summary: Load an equirectangular Radiance .hdr as the environment.

features.name: Add Background Shader...
features.summary: Add a user WGSL shader layer behind the scene.

features.name: Add Post Shader...
features.summary: Add a user WGSL shader layer as a post effect.

features.name: Save Project
features.summary: Write the project to its current path.
features.availability: needs a project that has been saved once

features.name: Export Bundle...
features.summary: Write a self-contained folder holding the project and a copy of every asset it uses.

features.name: Direct to Music
features.summary: Fold the track into musical sections and cut the camera between the world's heroes.
features.availability: needs analysed audio and a scene with heroes

features.name: Hand Camera Back to the Viewport
features.menu: Camera > Hand Camera Back to the Viewport
features.summary: Remove the camera's timeline automation so the mouse can move it again.

features.name: Restore Default Layout
features.summary: Rebuild the dock tree and reopen the panels the editor ships with.

features.name: Save Layout Now
features.summary: Write the dock tree and the open-panel set immediately.

features.name: Audio analysis
features.summary: The short-time Fourier transform, bands, onsets, beats and structure.

features.name: Modulation
features.summary: Signals, routes, parameters and the timeline.

features.name: Rendering
features.summary: The frame, lighting, shadows, volumetrics and post.

features.name: User shaders
features.summary: WGSL shader layers, their inputs and the binding contract.

features.name: MIDI and OSC
features.summary: External control in and parameter feedback out.

features.name: Performance tooling
features.summary: The GPU frame timeline, the CPU phase profiler and the A/B flags.

features.name: Menu commands
features.summary: Every entry in the menu bar.

features.name: Keyboard shortcuts
features.summary: The six keys AV Gen binds.

features.name: Command line
features.summary: Flags, environment variables and exit codes.
